text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, there were no detected thermal anomalies (such as fires) on this property during the period from October 4, 2026, to November 3, 2026. Multiple sensors (VIIRS and MODIS) provided continuous coverage, and no fire-related activity was recorded in the NASA FIRMS database for this timeframe. However, note that very small, short-duration, or cool fires—especially if obscured by clouds—might not be detectable by these systems.
